vw_ordercolor:
CREATE VIEW [dye].[vw_OrderColor]

AS

SELECT a.SheetSeries,a.SheetNo,b.CheckNo,a.SheetDate,CustomerID,a.ContractNo,a.CustSelfNo,b.ProdID,CustFabricName,b.ColorNum,b.ColorID,b.CustColorNum,b.OrderRolls,b.OrderQty,a.AssignUnit

FROM dye.OrderMain  a LEFT JOIN dye.OrderColor b ON a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries

WHERE a.CustomerID IN ('039','055') AND a.AssignUnit IN (0,2)
vworder: CREATE VIEW dye.vwOrder AS SELECT a.SheetSeries,a.SheetNo,a.SheetKind,a.OrderKindID,a.CustomerID,a.ContractNo,b.ProdID,b.Spec,b.ColorNum,b.ColorID,CAST(NULL AS decimal(18,4)) AS OrderUp,CAST(NULL AS decimal(18,4)) AS OrderDn,b.WeightDn,b.WeightUp FROM dye.OrderMain a LEFT JOIN dye.OrderColor b ON a.SheetSeries=b.SheetSeries

vwordergraypreemption:
CREATE View [dye].[vwOrderGrayPreemption]

as

Select om.SheetSeries,om.SheetNo,om.SalerID,om.CustomerID,

oc.CheckNo,oc.ProdID,oc.LotNo,oc.Spec,

Sum(IsNull(oc.CardQty,0)-IsNull(pj.JobVats,0)) OrderPreeVats,

Sum(IsNull(oc.OrderRolls,0)-IsNull(pj.JobRolls,0)) OrderPreeRolls,

Sum(IsNull(oc.OrderQty,0)-IsNull(pj.JobQty,0)) OrderPreeQty

From OrderMain om

Join OrderColor oc on oc.SheetSeries=om.SheetSeries and IsNull(om.SheetStatus,0) not in (9,10) --9:终止,10:结算

Left Join 

(Select j.CheckNo,Count(SheetSeries) as JobVats,Sum(PreRolls) as JobRolls,Sum(PreVatQty) as JobQty From JobSheet j 

 Where j.SheetKind in (0,10,20,30) and Exists(Select 1 From GrayOutDetail gd Where gd.JobSheetNo=j.SheetNo)

 Group By j.CheckNo

)pj On pj.CheckNo=oc.CheckNo 

Where 1=1

Group By om.SheetSeries,om.SheetNo,om.SalerID,om.CustomerID,oc.CheckNo,oc.ProdID,oc.LotNo,oc.Spec
